title: Lady appears on Easter 2012 with wind and translucent cow

tellings.quote: She came at me at night out of the darkness as a wind the wind hit me and as I'm going backwards to the ground I see a translucent cow run over top of me

plain: On Easter 2012, at his home in North Carolina, a man named Chris Bledsoe says a female figure he calls the Lady came at him out of the darkness at night as a wind. He tells Michels the wind knocked him backwards, and as he fell to the ground he saw a see-through cow run right over him. Bledsoe tells it as his own experience, part of a life he says has been full of strange encounters.
